other_conditions: Worker must be engaged in building or construction work
Worker must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
Worker must have at least one year of membership with the Board
A maximum of two children of the registered construction worker are eligible
Child must have passed the 10th or 12th examination conducted by a board in Bihar
Child must have scored 60% or above in the examination
benefits_summary: Cash prizes ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000 per year for eligible children based on their 10th/12th exam scores.
